title: chore: always record product analytics, without flag or opt-out branch
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
Follow-up to #15024. Two removals, both making the measurement unconditional.

**Feature flag**
- Removes `TINYBIRD_ANALYTICS_ENABLED` / `VITE_TINYBIRD_ANALYTICS_ENABLED`. It was the only `*_ENABLED` var in the enter wrangler config and was set in `[env.test.vars]` only, so product events could never reach production.
- Matches the other three Tinybird ingest paths (generation, stripe, referral), which all send unconditionally. The `environment` column already separates local/staging/production rows.
- Drops the `Analytics` wrapper in the frontend — it existed only to read the Vite flag.

**DNT / Sec-GPC opt-out**
- Removes `optedOut()`, its four call sites and the browser-side `navigator.doNotTrack` / `globalPrivacyControl` checks.
- Removes the matching sentence from `PRIVACY_POLICY.md` §7 in the same commit — the code and the promise can't move separately. §11 still grants objection to legitimate-interest processing via hello@pollinations.ai.
- `captureAuthStage` goes too: it existed only to apply the guard at every auth site, so the three call sites now wait on `captureProductEvent` directly.

108 lines deleted, 34 added. Unchanged: no cookie, no browser identifier, no third-party SDK.

The Tinybird datasource and pipes are already deployed and promoted in both workspaces, so rows start arriving on the next production deploy.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

gist.summary: Product analytics events in enter.pollinations.ai now send unconditionally to Tinybird across environments, removing the Tinybird enabled flags, frontend Analytics wrapper, and browser DNT/Sec-GPC guard while retaining environment-separated rows.
gist.impact: After the next production deploy, product-event rows will arrive consistently alongside existing generation, Stripe, and referral ingestion, with no cookie, browser identifier, or third-party SDK added.
